chapters.title: Exploration today
chapters.transcript: As of September twenty-sixth, twenty twenty-six, robotic exploration of Mars continues. Curiosity is studying rock textures and banded terrain, while Perseverance is investigating geology and storing samples. A September report used earlier Perseverance observations to reconstruct repeated encounters between rock and water. Its publication date is not the date the rover first saw those rocks. Not every familiar mission is still operating. NASA declared MAVEN unrecoverable in June, after more than eleven years around Mars. ESCAPADE's two spacecraft launched in November twenty twenty-five, but their Mars science observations are still ahead. These investigations build evidence about changing environments and habitability. Intriguing chemistry deserves careful study; it does not, by itself, establish that life has been discovered.

chapters.title: The next journeys
chapters.transcript: The next journeys are plans, not completed achievements. Japan's MMX mission is scheduled to launch on October twentieth, twenty twenty-six, Japan time. It aims to explore Mars's moons and bring material from Phobos back to Earth. ESA's Rosalind Franklin rover is scheduled for late twenty twenty-eight, with a drill designed to reach two metres below the surface. There, it could examine material better protected from surface radiation. Meanwhile, the already launched ESCAPADE mission is preparing for its later work around Mars, studying how the solar wind affects the planet's atmosphere. Human exploration also remains a goal. NASA's Moon to Mars architecture describes capabilities to develop, rather than a guaranteed landing date. Launch schedules and mission plans can change, so this chapter carries its own checking date.

nasa-curiosity-september-2026.title: NASA — Curiosity Blog, Sols 5010–5015: Checking out the Bands
nasa-curiosity-september-2026.note: Published four days before cutoff; Earth planning date September 11, image September 14. Supports recent active rover work, not live telemetry or an exact September 26 position. The narration does not repeat the article's imprecise early-September milestone date.

nasa-perseverance-water-2026.title: NASA/JPL — NASA Discovery Reveals Complex Water Systems on Early Mars
nasa-perseverance-water-2026.note: Five days before cutoff. September 2026 publication interprets earlier fieldwork: arrival at Margin Unit September 2023; illustrated panorama October 8–16, 2023. Reports at least three water interactions, not evidence of confirmed life. More-about section describes rover operations and sample storage.

nasa-maven-ended-2026.title: NASA — NASA Says Farewell to MAVEN Mars Mission, Hosts Media Call Today
nasa-maven-ended-2026.note: June 3 is the end-of-mission announcement, not the date of last contact. NASA states the spacecraft is unrecoverable and no longer performs science or relay work. Supersedes older recovery-in-progress descriptions.

nasa-escapade-current.title: NASA Science — ESCAPADE
nasa-escapade-current.note: The dated event here is launch, not a Mars observation. Page last updated April 17, 2026; original publication date not shown. Active mission; launched November 13, 2025. Journey description schedules Earth departure in fall 2026 and nearly matching science orbits by mid-2028. Narration does not assert that the future Earth departure, arrival, or science phase has already occurred.

nasa-organics-caution-2026.title: NASA — NASA Study: Non-biologic Processes Don't Fully Explain Mars Organics
nasa-organics-caution-2026.note: NASA explicitly says more work is needed before conclusions about absence or presence of life. Used only for that methodological caution, not as a claim that this February study is the latest September result.

jaxa-mmx-launch-2026.title: JAXA — Launch of the MMX spacecraft onboard the H3 Launch Vehicle No. 10
jaxa-mmx-launch-2026.note: Scheduled October 20, 2026, 04:41:03 JST; backup period October 21–November 7. Official mission news article and MMX home page agree. This is a future scheduled launch, not a completed event.

jaxa-mmx-mission.title: JAXA — MMX Mission Overview / Mission Flow
jaxa-mmx-mission.note: Undated mission description, directly checked. Objective is investigating Martian moons and returning a Phobos sample. Broad JFY 2026 schedule is refined by the August 20 dated launch announcement. No sample-return success is implied.

esa-rosalind-franklin.title: ESA Exploration Science — ExoMars Rosalind Franklin
esa-rosalind-franklin.note: Undated mission overview, directly checked. Launch planned late 2028; drill maximum vertical reach two metres, targeting subsurface material protected from surface radiation. Hardware design and scientific aim, not accomplished drilling or guaranteed life detection.

esa-exomars-ramps-2026.title: ESA — ExoMars ramps put up with cold, shaking and vacuum
esa-exomars-ramps-2026.note: Recent dated corroboration of the 2028 launch plan; describes hardware tests and intended 2030 landing. Neither test results nor the schedule establish that the rover is already on Mars.

nasa-moon-mars-architecture.title: NASA — Moon to Mars Architecture
nasa-moon-mars-architecture.note: Page last updated September 24, 2026, two days before cutoff; original publication date not shown. NASA distinguishes its evolving architecture from a mission or launch manifest. Used for long-term human-exploration purpose, with no promised human Mars landing date.
